title: Bedrock Llama Request Schema
description: Request schema for Meta Llama models via AWS Bedrock InvokeModel API

prompt.description: Formatted prompt using Llama instruction template tags. Example: <|begin_of_text|><|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>\n\nHello<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

notes: Llama models do NOT support tool calling
Llama models do NOT support system messages (prepend system instructions to first user message)
Llama 4 Instruct does NOT support streaming
